title: Domain Event Pattern — Companion Files
description: Runnable Domain Event pattern in three languages: immutable event object, an Order aggregate that collects and drains events, and an in-memory publisher with real subscribers (email + analytics) in Python, JavaScript, and Java.
description_es: Patrón Domain Event ejecutable en tres lenguajes: objeto de evento inmutable, un aggregate Order que acumula y drena eventos, y un publisher in-memory con suscriptores reales (email + analíticas) en Python, JavaScript y Java.
